controls.establishes: Pinned CodeQL security-extended analysis is configured for repository Python and JavaScript/TypeScript on pull requests, main pushes, manual runs, and a weekly schedule.
controls.does_not_establish: A vulnerability-free repository, penetration test, runtime scan, external audit, security certification, or production authorization.

controls.establishes: A pinned pull-request gate is configured to reject newly introduced high or critical dependency vulnerabilities in runtime and development scopes.
controls.does_not_establish: That the existing dependency set is vulnerability-free, that every undeclared dependency is inventoried, or that a proposed change has been approved for production.

controls.establishes: The dashboard dependency contract resolves GHSA-fgmj-fm8m-jvvx through ECharts 6.1.0, resolves GHSA-hmw2-7cc7-3qxx through form-data 4.0.6, upgrades Anime.js to 4.5.0 and Three.js to 0.185.1, and removes the unused model-viewer 4.3.1 package whose Three.js ^0.183.0 peer range made the proposed graph impossible under strict npm resolution. The pull-request gate uses strict npm peer resolution, npm tree validation, an audit threshold, registry provenance and integrity checks, peer-contract checks, and a module-load smoke test without force or legacy-peer bypasses.
controls.does_not_establish: Closure of GitHub alerts before this change reaches the default branch, replacement of the separately vendored public visual assets, absence of other vulnerabilities, browser or GPU compatibility with every dashboard, field performance, runtime safety, or production approval.

controls.establishes: Weekly update proposals are configured for GitHub Actions, the reviewer Python dependencies, dashboard npm dependencies, and the reviewer container base image.
controls.does_not_establish: Automatic merge, compatibility, remediation completion, production deployment, or approval of any proposed update.

controls.establishes: A private vulnerability-reporting route and bounded response process are published.
controls.does_not_establish: A bug bounty, response-time guarantee, third-party monitoring service, external audit, or enterprise service-level agreement.

controls.establishes: Severity, containment, remediation-target, exception-expiry, compensating-control, and closure-receipt expectations are documented for repository findings.
controls.does_not_establish: That every finding is remediated, that the targets are contractual guarantees, or that VPS, gateway, cloud-account, secret, network, and production-runtime controls were tested.

controls.establishes: An exact first-party remote observation records GitHub secret scanning and push protection enabled, 28 deterministic deployment-stage identifier false positives resolved, and one historical provider-key alert retained open while the detected value remains absent from the current tracked tree.
controls.does_not_establish: Provider rotation, revocation, Git-history remediation, removal from forks or caches, whole-repository secret absence, external security audit, or production authorization.

controls.establishes: The exact first-party remote observation records that the default main branch was not protected at the observation time and keeps the repository decision on HOLD.
controls.does_not_establish: That branch protection is configured, that direct pushes or force pushes are prevented, that reviews or status checks are enforced by GitHub settings, or that later remote state is unchanged.
